name: 28387 · Southern Pnes, NC
findings: ZIP 28387 (Southern Pnes) has 109 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28387 (Southern Pnes) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 28387 (Southern Pnes) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).
